background_story: In a lush meadow filled with vibrant wildflowers, Lambkin the rabbit made her home. Among her favorite haunts was a patch of fragrant verbena, whose delicate purple blooms and sweet scent brought her immense joy. As the seasons changed, Lambkin would tend to the verbena with care, ensuring its beauty was preserved for all to enjoy. She'd gently prune the stems, making sure the flowers received just the right amount of sunlight. As the verbena bloomed, its fragrance would attract a variety of beneficial insects, which in turn would pollinate the surrounding wildflowers. Lambkin's love for the verbena had a profound impact on the meadow's ecosystem, earning her the title of 'Guardian of the Verbena' among the other creatures.
